assessment: This study investigates the presence of DNA adenine methylation (6mA) and the associated function of TET enzyme, a DNA methylation mark eraser, in Drosophila. The study presents valuable findings on the scarcity of 6mA in the Drosophila genome and challenges previous findings regarding the role of TET in 6mA modification. The evidence supporting the claims is solid, and the paper has the potential to stimulate re-evaluations of the significance and regulatory mechanisms of 6mA DNA modifications in Drosophila.
